data.why: A tall room-in-section shows a traction elevator built as one rig: a car on a rope over a wheel, then a counterweight, rails and a safety gear. The camera starts on the car and rope, moves to the motor and its load gauge, then stays wide on the whole shaft. Every problem is visible (a red load gauge, a stalled car, a swinging car, a snapped rope) and each fix is a part that appears and cancels it. The finish adds doors, a button panel and a ceiling light inside the car, which then glides to the floor.

ideas.idea: pull a box up on a rope over a wheel and you already have an elevator
a full car weighs about a thousand kilograms and the motor alone has to lift all of it
the motor stalls and the car sinks back to the floor
hang a counterweight on the other end of the rope so the motor lifts only the difference
this whole rope, wheel, motor and counterweight machine is a traction elevator
the motor turns a grooved wheel, the ropes grip it, and the car rises as the counterweight sinks
the counterweight weighs as much as the car plus about forty percent of a full load, so the two nearly balance
the light car and the counterweight now swing loose in the shaft
bolt steel rails up the shaft so the car rides on them and stops swinging
if a rope snaps, nothing stops the car from falling
add a safety clamp that grips the rails, the trick Elisha Otis showed in 1854
the clamp that bites the rails is called a safety gear
one rope is not all that holds you up (the single rope gets crossed out)
a real car hangs from four to eight steel ropes, each strong enough to hold it alone
add sliding doors, a button panel and a ceiling light, and the car glides down to the floor
calm: the finished elevator waits at the floor with its doors open

chain.shows: the load gauge climbs into the red and the car sinks back to the floor
chain.stakes: the motor stalls and nobody can ride

chain.shows: the car and counterweight swing loose in the shaft
chain.stakes: riders get thrown about and the car scrapes the walls

chain.shows: a rope snaps and the car plunges down its track
chain.stakes: everyone inside would fall to the bottom
